sections.A: Non-specific kamar dard woh dard hai jis ki koi khaas wajah (fracture, tumour, infection ya nerve root) nahi milti. Yeh sab se aam kamar dard hai aur aksar theek ho jata hai.
sections.B: Kamar ke neeche dard jo kuch movements ya positions se barhta aur kuch se kam hota hai. Kooleh ya ran tak ja sakta hai, lekin nerve ke pattern mein ghutne se neeche nahi.
sections.C: Kab aur kaise shuru hua, kya barhata aur kya kam karta hai, raat ko jagata hai ya nahi, aur red flags: yeh sawaal mechanical aur serious dard ka farq batate hain.
sections.D: Posture aur chaal, kamar ki movements, baar baar movement ka asar (repeated movements), aur neuro screen.
sections.E: Yeh tests koi khaas tuuti hui cheez nahi batate. Yeh treatment chunne aur behtari check karne mein madad karte hain.
sections.F: Sciatica (ghutne se neeche nerve pattern), spinal stenosis aur doosri conditions ka farq table mein hai.
sections.G: Saddle area mein sunn-pan, peshab ya pakhane ki nayi tabdeeli, dono taangon mein barhti kamzori: yeh cauda equina ka khatra hai, foran emergency.
sections.H: Pehle emergency flags, phir urgent flags, phir ghutne se neeche nerve signs (Chapter 2). Kuch na ho aur dard mechanical ho to non-specific kamar dard.
sections.I: Halki mobilisation aur soft tissue kaam se thori der ka aaraam milta hai. Asal ilaaj exercise aur active rehna hai.
sections.J: Walking, pelvic tilts, cat-camel, bridge, bird-dog aur dheere dheere taaqat barhana.
sections.K: Garmi aaraam ke liye. TENS, ultrasound aur traction aam taur par recommend nahi.
sections.L: Pehli visit: flags screen karein, samjhayein ke serious wajah ka imkaan kam hai, aur active rehne ki salah dein. Phir exercise barhayein aur kaam par wapsi.
sections.M: Dard, ODI ya Roland-Morris, patient ka goal, movement aur chalne ki salahiyat dobara napein.
sections.N: 38 saal ke delivery driver ko boxes uthane ke baad kamar dard hai. Pehle khud plan socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: samjhana, tasalli aur active rehna sab se pehle; exercise asal ilaaj hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
